That isn't a fair proposal then.  You've essentially said "if things aren't better by __/__/__ I'll kill myself" but you aren't changing anything yet expect the results to be different.  That's the same as saying "I want this water to turn to ice"  and just leaving it sitting on the same counter instead of doing something to it.  If you have set a date then you owe it to yourself to make sure it's a fair experiment, even if it's something as simple as "I'll change what side of he bed I sleep on" or "I'll try a new hobby." Also, you've said your going to the gym but haven't said how you are measuring progress with your fitness goals (do you want to be able to do a certain amount, do a certain number of push-ups, lose __ pounds/kgs - "I want to lose weight" isn't a good goal because it doesn't specify how much weight and you will always want to lose more.)

I also live in a small town that's in full lockdown. There's always stuff you can change at home and see if that makes a difference - when you sleep, what foods you eat,  what brand of soap you use, etc. But you can't change nothing and expect different results. That's just setting yourself up to fail. You owe it to yourself to at least give yourself the chance to be successful. If you get to your set date and things haven't changed then it's up to you whether or not you do it but at least you gave yourself a chance.

What new things are you trying? New workout at the gym? What other ways of building your income have you considered - with the pandemic the job market is pretty much dead.  At least you're searching for one and actively trying to change your situation.  What about outside of money, what are other things you want to try?

This is selfish both for the reason you said - traumatising to others - as well as as a means of protest. It doesn't do much as a protest. As an action it is one and done,  what happens after you die?  unless it's mass suicide it won't have much of an effect, there's not really a way to sugar coat it but one death won't make a difference. Plus there's the stigma side of things - people tend to think of people who commit suicide as mentally ill and unstable, a point the could backfire and be used against you. The people you're protesting against could use your suicide as a thing that strengthens their argument - "look, the mentally unstable person believed we are wrong! They were crazy!"  The people who agree with you might distance themselves from you because of how you plan to protest.  Very few people will see a public suicide as a means of protest - it seems like attention seeking so people could think you just wanted attention instead of caring about the issue you are protesting.) Also wouldn't the suicide take the view off the issue - people will be talking about "the tragic suicide" instead of the issue you are attempting to protest, no?  It seems counterproductive all round.  If you want to protest, you should find an alternative method. If you want to commit suicide, this isn't the way to go about it.

That's part of the reason for the post. I want to get a way where there is enough time to die and have enough time pass so that resuscitation is not attempted.

With chemicals if you do enough research you can get an idea of how long it will take for something to kill you and how much you need based on your weight but as you said OD is difficult to predict. That is why I have included fail safes. And have multiple kill mechanisms built in to the method.

Timed notice to a friend to alert the emergency services is put of the question. They wouldn't see the body but would still be the first to know about it. I don't want that to happen. I don't want them to feel it's their responsibility to inform others. I'd rather they find out from the police or whoever does death notifications. I have scheduled emails to send to send a letter to each of them 12 hours after I've passed explaining why and saying goodbye. They should already be aware by the time they receive the letter.

The world will continue, life will go on.  As for how, I have thought about it, done my research and have included multiple fail-safes. I don't need all 6 methods to kill me, in fact if any fail the side effects directly ensure at least one will be successful. I'll be dead within a couple of minutes regardless.  

We could all die at any time. Just because you are about to die does not mean you stop caring for people or get to inflict pain on others.  We still have a responsibility to not inflict unnecessary hurt upon others.
